IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. COLLATZ.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 RAW     PIC X(12).
       01 CUR     PIC 9(12).
       01 MAXV    PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01 STEPS   PIC 9(5) VALUE 0.
       01 Q       PIC 9(12).
       01 R       PIC 9(1).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           ACCEPT RAW.
           COMPUTE CUR = FUNCTION NUMVAL(RAW).
           MOVE CUR TO MAXV.
       LOOP-PARA.
           IF CUR = 1 GO TO DONE-PARA.
           DIVIDE CUR BY 2 GIVING Q REMAINDER R.
           IF R = 0
               MOVE Q TO CUR
           ELSE
               COMPUTE CUR = CUR * 3 + 1
           END-IF.
           ADD 1 TO STEPS.
           IF CUR > MAXV MOVE CUR TO MAXV.
           GO TO LOOP-PARA.
       DONE-PARA.
           DISPLAY STEPS " " MAXV.
           STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DAYOFYR.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 RAW-DATE   PIC X(8).
       01 DATE-NUM   PIC 9(8).
       01 DATE-PARTS REDEFINES DATE-NUM.
           05 YYYY   PIC 9(4).
           05 MM     PIC 9(2).
           05 DD     PIC 9(2).
       01 DAYS-TABLE.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 31.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 28.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 31.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 30.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 31.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 30.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 31.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 31.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 30.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 31.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 30.
           05 FILLER PIC 9(2) VALUE 31.
       01 DAYS-REDEF REDEFINES DAYS-TABLE.
           05 DAYS-IN OCCURS 12 TIMES PIC 9(2).
       01 I          PIC 9(2).
       01 TOTAL      PIC 9(3) VALUE 0.
       01 Q          PIC 9(4).
       01 R4         PIC 9(4).
       01 R100       PIC 9(4).
       01 R400       PIC 9(4).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           ACCEPT RAW-DATE.
           MOVE RAW-DATE TO DATE-NUM.
           PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I >= MM
               ADD DAYS-IN(I) TO TOTAL
           END-PERFORM.
           ADD DD TO TOTAL.
           DIVIDE YYYY BY 4 GIVING Q REMAINDER R4.
           DIVIDE YYYY BY 100 GIVING Q REMAINDER R100.
           DIVIDE YYYY BY 400 GIVING Q REMAINDER R400.
           IF MM > 2
               IF R400 = 0 OR (R4 = 0 AND R100 NOT = 0)
                   ADD 1 TO TOTAL
               END-IF
           END-IF.
           DISPLAY TOTAL.
           STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SHIPRATE.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 RAW-W     PIC X(8).
       01 RAW-Z     PIC X(8).
       01 WGT       PIC 9(3)V9.
       01 ZONE      PIC 9.
           88 LOCAL-ZONE  VALUE 1 2.
           88 FAR-ZONE    VALUE 3 THRU 5.
       01 RATE      PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 0.
       01 OUT-RATE  PIC ZZ9.99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           ACCEPT RAW-W.
           ACCEPT RAW-Z.
           COMPUTE WGT = FUNCTION NUMVAL(RAW-W).
           COMPUTE ZONE = FUNCTION NUMVAL(RAW-Z).
           EVALUATE TRUE ALSO TRUE
               WHEN LOCAL-ZONE ALSO WGT <= 5
                   MOVE 4.50 TO RATE
               WHEN LOCAL-ZONE ALSO WGT > 5
                   COMPUTE RATE = 4.50 + (WGT - 5) * 0.75
               WHEN FAR-ZONE ALSO WGT <= 5
                   MOVE 9.00 TO RATE
               WHEN FAR-ZONE ALSO ANY
                   COMPUTE RATE = 9.00 + (WGT - 5) * 1.25
               WHEN OTHER
                   DISPLAY "BAD ZONE"
                   STOP RUN
           END-EVALUATE.
           MOVE RATE TO OUT-RATE.
           DISPLAY "RATE " OUT-RATE.
           STOP RUN.

echo implode(",", $vals), PHP_EOL;

echo implode(",", $vals), PHP_EOL;
